rules.statement: A mortgagee can sue one of several joint and several obligors even after obtaining a judgment against another, as long as the remaining obligor is still liable.
rules.supporting_quote: "The real question, therefore, is this-even assuming for the sake of argument that the liability of the wife, and her representatives, as a personal debtor was extinguished by prescription, but the liability of the husband for the entire debt remained, he having interrupted prescription-can the mortgagee enforce his claim against the whole of the mortgaged property?"
